sectionIntro: My 18 Royale Dances, Lights of Legacy, Jewels of Grace, Golden Blessings, and Toasts of Elegance—see the full list below.

categories.name: Roses
categories.title: Royale Dances
categories.description:
For my 18 Royale Dances, I have chosen gentlemen who mean a lot to me to join me for this celebration.

When your group is called, we'll share a dance and present a rose to mark this milestone together.

Thank you for being part of my debut story—I can't wait to celebrate with you.

categories.name: Candles
categories.title: Lights of Legacy
categories.description:
For my 18 Lights of Legacy, I have chosen each of you because your friendship has meant the world to me.

When you are called, please light a candle with me and share a favorite memory or a wish for my future.

Thank you for being with me through every chapter—I'm so grateful to celebrate this moment with you.

categories.name: Treasures
categories.title: Jewels of Grace
categories.description:
For my 18 Jewels of Grace, you are the treasures who have shaped my journey and made it shine.

Thank you for being part of this milestone—your presence is the greatest gift I could ask for.

categories.name: Bills
categories.title: Golden Blessings
categories.description:
For my 18 Golden Blessings, thank you for your generosity and for blessing this milestone with me.

Your presence and support mean more than words can say.

categories.name: Shots
categories.title: Toasts of Elegance
categories.description:
For my 18 Toasts of Elegance, thank you for standing with me as I toast to this new chapter.

When your name is called, join me for a celebratory shot and a cheer to the years ahead.

I'm grateful you're part of my debut night.
